levels.name: Finger walk
levels.hint: Follow the program with your finger, one block at a time.

levels.name: Whose left?
levels.hint: Pretend you are the robot. Which way is its left now?

levels.name: About turn
levels.prog: F F F R R F
levels.hint: Turns stay on the spot. Which way is the robot facing at the end?

levels.name: Splash stop
levels.prog: F F R F F L F F
levels.hint: Before each step, check that the square ahead is free.

levels.name: Times table
levels.hint: Count the steps inside the Repeat, then multiply.

levels.name: Three sides
levels.hint: Each round walks one side. How many sides will there be?

levels.name: Stair climb
levels.hint: Draw the first round with your finger, then do it again.

levels.name: Bracket hunt
levels.hint: Find where the Repeat ends. Blocks after it run only once.

levels.name: Square plus one
levels.hint: Draw one side, then all four. Where does the square leave the robot?

levels.name: Read F1 first
levels.prog: f R f L f|F F
levels.hint: Read the F1 row first. Each F1 means: do that row here.

levels.name: Nearly home
levels.hint: F1 ends with a turn, so each F1 starts facing a new way.

levels.name: Rock says turn
levels.hint: Each round does one thing: a step or a turn. Count the rounds.

levels.name: Round the hedge
levels.hint: After every step, look to the robot's right. Is the way open?

levels.name: Gem signposts
levels.hint: After each step, ask: is the robot standing on a gem?

levels.name: Gone gem
levels.hint: Can the robot pick up the same gem twice?

levels.name: Growing lines
levels.hint: Write n on paper and change it each time you read + or -.

levels.name: Empty rounds
levels.hint: Keep track of n. What does Repeat n do when n is 0?

levels.name: Counted once
levels.hint: Repeat n looks at n once, as it starts. Write n down each time.

levels.name: Smart steps
levels.hint: Each F1 is one smart move: a step or a turn. Count them.

levels.name: Master reader
levels.prog: r2(f) + f g(L) r3(i(F)(L)) - rn(F)|R rn(F)
levels.hint: Read it in parts. Where is the robot after each part?
